dialect.detail: IBM mainframe-style COBOL with VSAM KSDS indexed files, COMP-3 packed decimal, RECORDING MODE F, RETURN-CODE special register, and GOBACK. Turkish field names (Tarih=date, Tutar=amount, Ad=name, Soyad=surname, DVZ=currency/division) suggest a Turkish banking or financial application possibly running on IBM z/OS.
evidence: VSAM KSDS with ORGANIZATION INDEXED and STATUS codes
FUNCTION NUMVAL-C, FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DAY, FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER (COBOL-85 intrinsic functions)

purpose.domain_detail: Currency/account balance lookup and reporting; Turkish field names (DVZ=döviz/currency, Tutar=amount, Tarih=date) suggest foreign currency account processing
purpose.summary: The program reads sequential account records (ACCT-REC), looks up matching records in a VSAM indexed file (IDX-FILE) by account ID and division/currency code, retrieves currency name from a currency database (DVZDB-FILE), converts Julian dates to Gregorian, updates balances, and writes formatted output to a print file. It is a batch reporting/update program for account balance processing.

notable_features: VSAM KSDS indexed file access (ORGANIZATION INDEXED, ACCESS RANDOM)
RECORDING MODE F on sequential files
FUNCTION NUMVAL-C and FUNCTION NUMVAL for string-to-numeric conversion
FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DAY and FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER for date conversion
RETURN-CODE special register for error propagation
Turkish language identifiers and display messages
88-level condition names with multiple values (00 97 for success)
Multiple indexed file lookups with INVALID KEY handling
verdict.notes: Turkish field names and display messages (Ad, Soyad, Tarih, Tutar, DVZ=döviz) strongly suggest a Turkish educational or training exercise, possibly from a university course on COBOL/mainframe programming. The program structure is functional but has some rough edges (e.g., DISPLAY 'ID : ' IDX-LNAME instead of IDX-ID, DVZDB-FILE not closed in H999). Filename HWORK3.cbl suggests 'homework 3'. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS present.
